neighbours.label: A word in the middle of a multi-word Title Case title or headline (book and film names, news headlines, how-to and listicle headings such as 'Ten Tips for Keeping Your Kitchen Clean'); quiet for the same words in ordinary lowercase prose and for very short titles of two or three words. Side case: the second half of the Japanese word 運営 (operation) also fires.
fire: 所有と運営を一体とする日本の観光産業でいち早く運営特化戦略をとり、運営サービスを提供するビジネスモデルへ転換。
